description:
[Merchant] Register an audio file (soundbite) for a product to enable audio-based payment initiation.

**Supported formats:** MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, FLAC, AAC, WMA, MP4, MOV, up to 100 MB, holding 2 to 120 seconds of audio
**Note:** For video files, only the audio channel is registered

audioPath.description: Path to the audio file to upload (e.g., '/path/to/audio.mp3')

partnerId.description: Merchant partner ID (uses PAYWARE_PARTNER_ID env var as default)

privateKey.description: RSA private key for authentication (uses environment-specific private key as default)

name: payware_products_register_audio
